decision.evidence:
The SOSA subgroup discussed the move in its meeting of 2023-09-21 (review of PR #97 by
R. Atkinson: "Discussed in meeting 21/09/2023") and merged PR #97 "Mirror ssn resources in sosa"
("All SSN classes and properties cloned into SOSA namespace and graph … Fixes #48") the same day,
2023-09-21T22:43Z, merge commit a43e70b2; issue #48 ("Should we merge SSN and SOSA into a single
namespace?", opened 2023-05-04) was closed that day. No W3C-hosted minutes exist for that meeting.
The ssn: copies were deprecated and the specification text switched to sosa: by PR #133,
2023-12-11. First publication on /TR/: FPWD of 2025-09-16. The namespace document at
http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/ still served the 2017 graph on 2026-11-14 (w3c/ns#41 open).
decision.earlier_resolution:
SDWIG, TPAC Lyon, 2018-10-23: "add an hasProperty property to the SOSA namespace …
as errata change" (https://www.w3.org/2018/10/23-sdw-minutes.html#x05); never implemented as an
erratum. The 2017 Recommendation itself writes sosa:hasProperty in example B.10 (reported in #81,
2017-12-09, not in the errata).
